title: yummy and tangy Mexican chiles Quesadilla
description: Fermented, shaggy, sick-day Mexican dish featuring whipping cream, en-croute, sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: In a blender, puree the fermented chiles, cumin, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper until smooth.
Heat the chicken broth in a pan over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix the whipping cream and the chile puree.
In a skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Place a large flour tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Pour the whipped cream and chile mixture over the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook for 2 minutes or until the cheese melts.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2 minutes.
In a separate pan, melt the remaining butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the chopped cilantro and cook for 1 minute.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve with the onion and cilantro mixture on top.
